g.text: Sequence: Admin copies the previous week's roster
open "Lịch trực theo tuần", go to the target week
200 { weekStart, weekEnd, days, shifts, rooms, doctors, entries }
target = same doctor, room, shift, maxPatients;
CopySummary: "Đã sao chép n ca trực …",
the grid reloads with the new entries
